question: Who among the following won the 2024 US Open Women's Singles title?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aryna Sabalenka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Aryna Sabalenka** won the **2024 US Open Women's Singles title**, marking a significant achievement in her career.
 
• She defeated **Jessica Pegula** in the final match, showcasing exceptional skill and determination.
 
• The US Open 2024 was held at the **USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center** in New York City.
 
• Her win is seen as a breakthrough moment, solidifying her position as a rising star in the world of tennis.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **US Open:**

 
 
• The US Open is one of the **four Grand Slam tournaments**, alongside Wimbledon, the Australian Open, and the French Open.
 
• It is held annually in **August-September** and is played on a **hard court surface**.
 
 
 
• **Coco Gauff:**
 
 
• Coco Gauff is an American professional tennis player who turned pro in 2018.
 
• She is known for her powerful baseline game and her ability to handle high-pressure matches.
 
 
 
• **Aryna Sabalenka:**
 
 
• Aryna Sabalenka, from Belarus, is currently ranked among the top players in the world.
 
• She has alos won the **2023 Australian Open.**
 
 
 
• **Grand Slam Titles:**
 
 
• Winning a Grand Slam is a pinnacle achievement in tennis, requiring exceptional skill and consistency across multiple matches.
 
• Players who win all four Grand Slams in a year achieve the rare distinction of a **Calendar Grand Slam**.
